newsitem.title: ITALY: Bologna to issue first muni bonds in September.
newsitem.headline: Bologna to issue first muni bonds in September.

text.p: Bologna city council said it will issue in September 15 billion lire worth of municipal bonds as the first tranche of a medium-term note programme for a total value equal to 120 billion lire.

Moody's Investors Service on Tuesday assigned an Aa2 rating to the Italian city's forthcoming lira-denominated notes. Bologna already has a Standard & Poor's long-term foreign debt rating of AA and AA+ for long-term lira debt.
Several Italian municipalities have already issued muni bonds known as BOC (Buoni Ordinari Comunali).
Bologna city council said in a statement that the BOC issues would finance part of the city's plan of investment in public works already approved for the three year period 1997-99.
The issue programme to start in September will be on the domestic market but Bologna is also looking at the Euromarket.
